svg.title: How triplediff works: raw panel, ATT(g,t) building blocks, event study
svg.desc: Step 1: units grouped by enabling period S and eligibility Q over periods 1 to 3; a line sweeps across the periods and the treated cells turn orange. Step 2: for each ATT(g,t), only the data it uses stay in view, in periods g - 1 and t: the enabled eligible units, the ineligible units of the same group, and the groups not yet or never enabled. Each estimate joins a coefficient strip. Step 3: the event-study points appear; the links to the ATT(g,t) each point averages appear and disappear.
